region.description: left facade pillar stone, excluding window glass and dark trim

conclusion: The Web stone is about 7 levels brighter and more red-biased (R-B=7.0) than the original neutral stone (R-B=1.8). Reducing the recovered TintB opacity would remove the warmth but make the already-too-bright stone brighter, so the remaining difference is baked shadow/lightmap and missing grunge, not the base tint alone.
